newsitem.title: UK: Strong pound cuts Comm Union profits.
newsitem.headline: Strong pound cuts Comm Union profits.

text.p: Commercial Union Plc, affected by the strength of sterling, reported a dip in its operating pretax profit to 444 million pounds ($726.2 million) from 509 million on Wednesday.
The company offered a final dividend of 18.85 pence per share making a total 30.30 pence for the full year.
At comparable rate of exchange Commercial Union's operating profit for the year showed only a three percent dip from 460 million stg in 1995.
The group's life operations grew at 25 percent with its worldwide life, pensions and investment sales growing to 2.9 billion pounds.
In general insurance, Commercial Union gave out 41 million pounds in weather claims in the United States and faced tough competition in Britain.
The group said it achieved good results in France, the Netherlands and Canada but its general insurance profits of 356 million pounds were down 21 percent at comparable rates of exchange.
